anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

choices.why: He leaves handles for later readers, not a closed system.

pass_a_gloss: And let these things have been said by me to this much. Having sown fruitful starting-points through these engravings, so that the things said by us as in a little incompletely may be filled out in breadth through the well-disposed and learning-loving, as the Word set before us, so also to those according to the same of the grace in Christ may God grant.
pass_b_english: And let these things have been said by me to this extent. Having sown fruitful starting-points through these marks, so that what has been said by us as in a little, incompletely, may be filled out at large by those who are well-disposed and love learning — as the Word has set it before us, so also to them, according to the same grace that is in Christ, may God grant it.
source_text: Ταῦτα δὲ ἐπὶ τοσοῦτόν μοι εἰρήσθω. Ἀφορμὰς εὐκάρπους ἐγκατασπείρας διὰ τῶν|| ἐγχαράξεων τούτων, ἵνα τὰ ἡμῖν ὡς ἐν ὀλίγῳ ἐλλειπῶς λεχθέντα διὰ τῶν φιλοφρόνων καὶ φιλομαθῶν ἐν πλάτει προσαναπληρωθῇ, καθὼς ἡμῖν παρέστησεν ὁ λόγος, οὕτως κἀκείνοις κατὰ τὸ αὐτὸ τῆς ἐν Χ(ριστ)ῷ χάριτος παράσχοι ὁ θ(εό)ς. Ὠριγένους περὶ πάσχα ᾱ β
